meta.title: WoW Forever Rogue spell ranks, every level 1-60

status_legend.forever: Forever client data (build 1.60.1.70862) as carried by wowsims-forever

source.records: sim/core/spelldata/spells_auto_gen.go (wowsims's generator bakes in tools/database/overrides; any override comment is copied to the rank's wowsims_overrides: those fields are wowsims's in-game measurements, not client rows)
source.vanilla: cmangos classic-db spell_template (1.12) for vanilla_* fields, npc_trainer_template 41 + npc_trainer rows of class 4 trainers for vanilla_trainer (teach spell -> learned spell through effect 36 LEARN_SPELL)

formulas.value_at_level: BasePoints + PPL * clamp(min(L, scaling_max_level) - scaling_base_level, 0); scaling_max_level 0 = no cap. Computed in float32 as wowsims Effect.AverageAt. Damage/heal amounts keep the fraction; every other amount is floored.
formulas.cost: cost.mana flat; cost.pct_base_mana = pct of base mana (base_mana table in <class>_levels.json); cost.rage in rage (row value / 10); cost.energy; cost.combo_points_min = the finisher needs at least that many; cost.health (Life Tap row has none: wowsims spends amount + Spirit).
formulas.learn_level: SpellLevels.SpellLevel of the rank (client). learned_from.vanilla_trainer gives the vanilla 1.12 trainer level and cost for comparison. 2 Nov notes: training every class ability 1-60 costs 206-207 gold in Forever, so vanilla costs are not Forever costs.
formulas.vanilla_compare: vanilla.changes_vs_vanilla compares learn level, flat cost, cooldowns and each effect's amount at the learn level (vanilla BasePoints+1 .. BasePoints+DieSides, Forever tooltip range) with the 1.12 row of the same id. A difference of 1 point or less is ignored. Cast times and durations are not compared (the 1.12 rows store index ids into tables not in the local data).
formulas.required_stance_mask: client StanceMask bit field (1 << (form id - 1)); e.g. warrior Battle 17, Defensive 18, Berserker 19; druid Cat 1, Bear 5, Dire Bear 8, Moonkin 31.

coefficient_penalties.finding: Neither wowsims-forever nor mythicsim-forever-engine applies the vanilla sub-20 penalty (1 - (20 - spellLevel)*0.0375) or a downrank coefficient penalty. Ranks learned below 20 carry sp_coef_if_vanilla_sub20_penalty so a sim can switch the vanilla rule on.
coefficient_penalties.forever_notes: kami-labs summary of the 2 Nov 2026 notes: the low-rank penalty was removed from several chance-based talents and stays on Arcane Concentration, Frostbite and Fingers of Frost (proc less often when the rank was learned more than 12 levels below the caster). Nothing in the notes speaks to damage/heal coefficients of low ranks.

forever_class_notes: Poisons: more charges, stack with stones; Deadly Poison AP coefficient 0.009, Instant Poison 0.01 (2 Nov notes). New: Shank (24, rank 2 44), Poised passive (18). One-handed axes usable. Feint threat doubled, Sap no longer breaks stealth, Expose Armor stronger (deep dive).
notes_sources: Warcraft Tavern summaries of Blizzard's Forever class deep dives: Priest & Warrior (1 Oct 2026, Blizzard news 24301514), Mage & Shaman (7 Oct, 24302097), Rogue & Warlock (7 Oct, 24310968); 'All Changes to Paladins' (21 Sep 2026); 'WoW Forever Pre-Launch Class Changes & Bug Fixes' (4 Nov 2026, from Kaivax's Beta Development Notes updated 2 Nov).
Blizzard news 'World of Warcraft: Forever Class Deep Dives - Hunter and Druid' (news.blizzard.com/en-us/article/24301515).
kami-labs 'WoW Forever November 2 patch: 223 changes before launch' (datamined items marked).
The Blizzard forum dev-notes thread itself could not be fetched here (needs approval); its content is taken from the summaries above.
Where a note and a client row disagree, the row wins; the row values are the ones in ranks[].

wowsims_code_notes.comment: [apScaling := 0.009 / numTicks] Confirmed by Zirene | [apScaling := 0.01] Confirmed by Zirene | [rogue.registerPoisonProc(consumable, 0.2, rogue.InstantPoison)] Confirmed in game 9/30/2026 || The poison items whose weapon imbue casts a rank of Deadly or Instant Poison. Each is the item's consumable effect, in place of the generic imbue builder, which would apply Deadly Poison's stacking damage over time as one. Whether a hand of the main set or of the item swap set carries the consumable's imbue. The rank of the ladder the consumable's imbue casts, 0 where it casts none of them. The highest rank of the ladder that any imbue the rogue carries casts. Both hands and both weapon sets share the one poison spell, so a lower rank on another weapon procs at this one. Casts the poison off the melee hits of the weapons carrying the consumable's imbue, at their own speeds, following the weapons through an item swap.

wowsims_code_notes.comment: [deathMarkStoredPerPoint = 0.12] $ratio: 12% of the damage per combo point. | [deathMarkCapAPPerPoint  = 0.04] $maxAP. || The mark's rates are stated only in the tooltip: description variables 1021 give $ratio and $maxAP, and the text of rank 4 (1325758), the rank the sim registers, caps the payout at ((156 + 245 per point + $maxAP*AP per point) * ($mcrit/100 + 1)) * $coup. The store carries neither. The mark stores a share of the damage the rogue's attacks, poisons and ticks deal its target, twice the share for Garrote and Rupture, and deals what it stored when it ends, up to a cap that its combo points, attack power and melee crit chance raise. The stored damage already carries every modifier, so the payout takes none again. Coup de Grace raises the storage rate and the cap, each on its own: below the cap the stored amount carries it, and the cap is raised by it too. Its second effect is a SPELLMOD_DAMAGE on Death Mark's class flags, which the sim applies to direct hits only, and the payout is a tick, so it is read here. The tooltip's $coup reads the talent's first effect, which states the same values. $mcrit is the melee crit chance the character sheet shows, before the target's level takes any.

wowsims_code_notes.comment: [apScaling := 0.009 / numTicks] Confirmed by Zirene | [apScaling := 0.01] Confirmed by Zirene | [rogue.registerPoisonProc(consumable, 0.2, rogue.InstantPoison)] Confirmed in game 9/30/2026 || The poison items whose weapon imbue casts a rank of Deadly or Instant Poison. Each is the item's consumable effect, in place of the generic imbue builder, which would apply Deadly Poison's stacking damage over time as one. Whether a hand of the main set or of the item swap set carries the consumable's imbue. The rank of the ladder the consumable's imbue casts, 0 where it casts none of them. The highest rank of the ladder that any imbue the rogue carries casts. Both hands and both weapon sets share the one poison spell, so a lower rank on another weapon procs at this one. Casts the poison off the melee hits of the weapons carrying the consumable's imbue, at their own speeds, following the weapons through an item swap.

notes: New in Forever (level 24): 5 energy, 10 s cooldown, 50% off-hand damage, generates 15 energy; rank 2 at 44 generates 25 (Warcraft Tavern 4 Nov).

wowsims_code_notes.comment: The row is Always Hit, so only the crit is rolled. It suppresses the caster's, the target's and the weapon procs, so Shank carries no proc mask: no trinket, talent or poison hears it, and the row's Suppress Weapon Procs flag keeps the weapon procs off as well. With no hand in its mask, a modifier scoped to the off hand does not reach it either. Shank is no builder, so Seal Fate does not hear it. TODO: validate in game that Suppress Caster Procs and Suppress Target Procs leave Shank heard by no proc. Flash of Steel's SPELLMOD_EFFECT2 raises the energy of the second effect; the parse would read it as damage, so it is added here.
